sections.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: This System Test Report documents end-to-end validation of the complete (S)TeemBang fitness tracking application against functional requirements FR1–FR8 defined in the SDLC scope document. System testing was performed by the development test group (Group 4) in a local integrated environment (Vue frontend + FastAPI backend + SQLite).

sections.heading: 2. System Test Scope
bullets: FR1: Secure user registration and authentication (JWT)
FR2: Workout logging with categories and calorie estimates
FR3: Daily step tracking (manual sync and simulation)
FR4: Calorie calculation using MET-based algorithms
FR5: Fitness goals (daily, weekly, monthly) with progress
FR6: Analytics dashboard and trend charts
FR7: Historical activity logs persisted in database

rows: SQLite steambang.db with seeded demo data

sections.heading: 5. Non-Functional Test Results
paragraphs: At least two non-functional categories were evaluated as required.

rows: Pass — all TCs on both browsers
Profile photo not displaying after upload
Pedometer required device sensors on desktop
Admin missing member daily target progress

sections.heading: 8. Overall Assessment
paragraphs: Total system test cases executed: 20. Passed: 20. Failed: 0. Pass rate: 100%.
All functional requirements FR1–FR8 are satisfied in the integrated system. Non-functional criteria for performance and security are met under local test conditions.
Recommendation: Proceed to User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
